_comment: RAG settings for the released-artifact smokes (WIN-06 / LIN-02). No `Llm` section on purpose: retrieval must work offline, and its absence keeps the WIN-01 echo fallback in play. The SQLite document store is what makes a two-process ingest-then-search meaningful — the default in-memory store dies with the `rag ingest` process, so `rag search` would always answer 'no relevant context'. `Data Source` is a VIRTUAL path: /output is the auto-injected rw mount (./.orkeon under the working directory).
